name: Share Breath (Mythic)
body:
You and your allies can share another’s breath above the waves or below them.

Prerequisite(s): Aquatic or water subtype.

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can imbue an ally with the ability to breathe water. Your ally must remain within 5 feet times your mythic rank or tier. This ability persists until you revoke it as a full-round action or until the creature moves farther from you than the above distance. If the ability ends while that creature is still underwater, it may begin to drown. If you expend one use of your mythic power, you can share this ability with a number of additional allies equal to your mythic rank or tier.
